title: Add low-RAM baseline benchmark harness
description: Create a repeatable benchmark harness for the same representative control-plane workload before and after changes on a documented host.
acceptanceCriteria: The harness records host OS/kernel, architecture, vCPU, RAM, swap, Node version, artifact size, and workload parameters
It measures install/startup separately from control-plane operations and does not claim tunnel throughput unless actually exercised
Output is machine-readable and sanitized, with no credentials or database contents
A baseline can be regenerated from a clean fixture and compared to a candidate run

steps.details: Choose representative health, node-list, tunnel-list, action, traffic, and log requests with fixed counts and concurrency; record them in evidence.
Test the harness parser/aggregation with a synthetic run and fail on missing metrics or malformed output.
Collect monotonic timing, process/resource data, HTTP status counts, and host metadata; redact URLs/tokens and database paths as needed.
Run the harness locally or on the approved VPS, record before metrics, and mark unavailable real-host evidence explicitly.

technicalNotes: Use monotonic clocks and fixed workload parameters; do not compare runs with different hosts as if they were equivalent.
